summary: This Phase 3 study compared two different study drugs, IBI362 and Semaglutide, in Chinese adults with early type 2 diabetes and obesity. Type 2 diabetes is a condition with high blood sugar, and obesity means having a high amount of body fat. The trial included 349 participants. The sponsor for this research was Innovent Biologics (Suzhou) Co. Ltd., and the status is Completed.
